muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /admin htmx(Admin(ctx))" -}}{{.HXPushURL "/admin"}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /public Public(ctx)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server serves an htmx admin UI next to plain HTML public pages: one route
// is framed, one is not, in the same file.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Admin(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "admin", nil }

func (Server) Public(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "public", nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("framed route sets an HX header", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if got, want := rec.Header().Get("HX-Push-Url"), "/admin"; got != want {
			t.Errorf("HX-Push-Url = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("unframed route carries no HX headers", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/public", nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		for name := range rec.Header() {
			if len(name) > 3 && name[:3] == "Hx-" {
				t.Errorf("unexpected %s header on the unframed route", name)
			}
		}
		if want := "<p>public</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
